fusions.name: Scattering Shoal
fusions.desc: Kicks up a spray of 4 darting water bolts, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Your movement speed rises 12% for 2 seconds after you use it. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Riverbank Rush
fusions.desc: Surges at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipping the Net
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You slip 2 tiles from where you stood and gain +10% dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Darting Getaway
fusions.desc: Each attack you dodge builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once and you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, the stacks fade.
